GUM.LibraryImport.ClearConfirmContent: Permanently delete every document and folder from ‘{name}’? This cannot be undone.
GUM.LibraryImport.Errors.CompendiumNotFo: The selected compendium could not be identified.
GUM.Settings.InitiativeFormula.Name: Initiative Formula (GUM)
GUM.Settings.InitiativeFormula.Hint: Standard GURPS formula: Basic Speed, with DX as the first tiebreaker and 1d6 as the second.
GUM.Settings.InitiativeFormula.ReloadCon: The initiative formula changed. Foundry must be reloaded for the change to take effect.
GUM.Settings.AddDefaultRules.Name: Passive Conditions on Characters
GUM.Settings.AddDefaultRules.Hint: Automatically add all conditions from the configured Passive Conditions sources to new characters.
GUM.Settings.SyncPassiveConditions.Name: Synchronize Passive Conditions
GUM.Settings.SyncPassiveConditions.Hint: CHECK and SAVE to update character Passive Conditions from the configured sources. The checkbox resets automatically after use.
GUM.Settings.HybridImportSearchAll.Name: Hybrid import: search other compendiums
GUM.Settings.HybridImportSearchAll.Hint: Also search every Item compendium after world items and configured sources during character import. This may select unexpected module content.
GUM.Settings.DefaultSkillRollFormula.Hin: Set the dice used for skill checks (for example: 3d6, 2d10, or 1d20).
GUM.Settings.AutoDistanceModifier.Name: Distance Modifier
GUM.Settings.AutoDistanceModifier.Hint: Automatically calculate the distance modifier in the Roll Prompt when there is an active attacker and exactly one selected target.
GUM.Settings.DistanceTable.Name: Distance Table
GUM.Settings.DistanceTable.Hint: Choose the table used for automatic distance calculations when Distance Modifier is enabled.
GUM.Settings.AutoSizeModifier.Name: Automatic Size Modifier
GUM.Settings.AutoSizeModifier.Hint: For attacks against one target, apply the target’s final SM using the basic rule or calculate relative SM (target SM minus source SM).
GUM.Settings.NormalizeDamageDice.Name: Normalize Damage Dice
GUM.Settings.NormalizeDamageDice.Hint: (GURPS: Modifying Dice + Adds) Automatically converts Xd6+Y/Xd6-Y formulas with large modifiers into more or fewer dice, without reducing below 1d6.
GUM.Settings.ImportGCSCharacter.Name: Import GCS Character
GUM.Settings.ImportGCSCharacter.Hint: Import a complete character sheet from a .gcs (JSON) file. This creates a new Actor.
GUM.Settings.ImportGCSTemplate.Name: Import GCS Template
GUM.Settings.ImportGCSTemplate.Hint: Import a .gct/.gcs GCS template and create a Template Item with blocks that can be applied to a character sheet.
GUM.Settings.ImportItemsJson.Name: Import Items (JSON)
GUM.Settings.ImportItemsJson.Hint: GM tool. Import a .json file containing Items (Skills, Advantages, and so on) into the corresponding system compendium.
GUM.Settings.ExportCompendiumJson.Name: Export Compendium (JSON)
GUM.Settings.ExportCompendiumJson.Hint: GM tool. Export the contents of an Item compendium to a .json file.
GUM.Settings.ExportCharacterJson.Name: Export Character Sheet (JSON)
GUM.Settings.ExportCharacterJson.Hint: Export a character sheet to a .json file for backup and reuse.

GUM.ContentSources.Heading: Content Sources
GUM.ContentSources.Introduction: Choose and order the libraries used by each feature. The first source has the highest priority.
GUM.ContentSources.Errors.SavePurpose: Could not save the sources for {purpose}.

GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.RollModifier: Libraries used by character sheets, roll prompts, and the GM Screen.
GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.Skills.Name: Skills
GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.Skills.Descr: Libraries used by test requests and canonical skill resolution.
GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.PassiveCondi: Libraries copied to new characters and used to synchronize passive conditions.
GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.StatusAutoma: Libraries that apply GUM effects in response to active Foundry statuses.
GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.CharacterImp: Additional libraries searched when replacing imported GCS items with GUM content.
GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.Effects.Name: Effects
GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.Effects.Desc: Libraries used by effect browsers and selectors.
GUM.ContentSources.Purposes.Triggers.Des: Libraries used by condition and effect editors.
GUM.ContentSources.Menu.Label: Configure sources
GUM.ContentSources.Menu.Hint: Choose the compendiums used by GUM browsers and automations.
GUM.StatusAutomations.RemoveOnStatusOff: Remove effects when status is removed
GUM.StatusAutomations.LegacySetting.Name: Status Automations Compendium
GUM.StatusAutomations.LegacySetting.Hint: ID of the compendium containing Condition Items in 'Status Binding' mode (for example, gum.status_bindings). If empty, gum.conditions is used.
